whoWeAre.label: About Us
whoWeAre.title: Who Are We?
whoWeAre.desc1: We are an institution that seeks to promote the development of pickleball in Mexico, generating synergy with all institutions responsible for promoting sports.
whoWeAre.desc2: We strive to provide Mexican athletes with the tools necessary to reach their maximum potential, allowing them to compete at national and international levels.
whoWeAre.mission_text: To promote, develop and regulate pickleball throughout Mexico, creating opportunities for athletes of all levels to grow and excel in this sport.
whoWeAre.vision_text: To establish Mexico as a leading nation in pickleball, with world-class athletes, facilities and a thriving community.
whoWeAre.value_excellence_desc: We seek the highest standards in everything we do.
whoWeAre.value_community_desc: Building strong connections among our members.
whoWeAre.value_growth_desc: Continuous development and improvement in every aspect.
whoWeAre.cta_sub: Be part of Mexico's fastest-growing Pickleball community

international.label: Global Affiliation
international.title: What is the International Pickleball Federation?
international.desc1: The International Pickleball Federation (IPF) is the international governing body responsible for promoting, developing and regulating pickleball worldwide.
international.desc2: Recently, the IPF merged with the World Pickleball Federation (WPF), giving rise to a new era for global pickleball under a unified structure known as Unified Pickleball.
international.affiliation_desc: Our Federation is affiliated with Unified Pickleball, officially connecting us with the international pickleball community. This affiliation ensures that our activities, regulations and competitions align with international standards.
international.benefit1_desc: Rules and regulations aligned with global practices
international.benefit4_desc: Access to development programs and resources
international.pillar1_desc: Consistent rules and regulations across all member nations, ensuring fair play and professional competition standards.
international.pillar2_desc: Access to an international network of federations, coaches and players, fostering collaboration and knowledge exchange.
international.pillar3_desc: Advanced training programs and resources designed to elevate athletes to world-class competition levels.
international.cta_sub: Be part of Mexico's connection with the global Pickleball community

categories.what_is_text: The NRTP (National Rating Tournament Program) is a player classification system originally adopted from tennis and adapted for pickleball, in order to organize players by skill level. This system allows for fairer, more balanced and competitive play by matching players with similar abilities.
